Name: ofds_id
Title: Identifier
Description: A locally-unique identifier for this wayleave.

Name: grantor
Title: Grantor
Description: The entity that grants a network operator the legal right to install, maintain, or operate telecommunications infrastructure on, over, or under property or assets.

Name: yearSigned
Title: Year signed
Description: The year in which this wayleave was signed.

Name: term__indefinite
Title: Term Indefinite
Description: Information about the duration of the wayleave. Whether the term of wayleave is indefinite, i.e. without an end date.

Name: term__years
Title: Term Years
Description: Information about the duration of the wayleave. If the wayleave's term is definite, its duration in years.

Name: cost__recurring
Title: Cost Recurring
Description: Information about the cost of the wayleave. Whether this is a recurring cost.

Name: cost__perMetre__amount
Title: Cost Cost per metre Amount
Description: Information about the cost of the wayleave. The average cost per metre for this wayleave. Wayleave costs can include a mix of per length and per item fees, e.g. a fee per metre of cable and a fee per pole. The average cost per metre should be calculated by dividing the total cost of all fees by the total length in metres of cable covered by the wayleave. For recurring fees, the average cost per metre should be annualised. The amount of this value.

Name: cost__perMetre__currency
Title: Cost Cost per metre Currency
Description: Information about the cost of the wayleave. The average cost per metre for this wayleave. Wayleave costs can include a mix of per length and per item fees, e.g. a fee per metre of cable and a fee per pole. The average cost per metre should be calculated by dividing the total cost of all fees by the total length in metres of cable covered by the wayleave. For recurring fees, the average cost per metre should be annualised. The currency of this value, from the closed [currency codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#currency).
